events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering a legend
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable voice and stage presence of Freddie Mercury, whose legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Album anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles shifted gears with "Rubber Soul," an album that still sounds remarkably fresh.

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: It's 46 years since we lost the legendary musician and peace activist, John Lennon.

angles.name: Tribute to John Lennon
angles.copy: Reflecting on the profound impact of John Lennon, a voice for peace and a musical visionary, 46 years on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The iconic David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Tribute to Bowie
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman on what would have been his 80th birthday, a true innovator who constantly reinvented music and style.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley, the original King, on what would have been his 92nd birthday.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin's legendary guitarist, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro of the riff, Jimmy Page – still shaping the sound of rock.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod Stewart
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, still rocking at 82 and proving some voices just get better with age.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs from Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Suggs
angles.copy: One step beyond! Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The smooth voice of Paul Young, known for hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat," turns 71 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Paul Young
angles.copy: We're wherever he lays his hat for Paul Young's 71st birthday – still a true 80s icon.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music superstar Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Dolly Parton
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton – still working 9 to 5 and looking fabulous.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gary Barlow
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow, the man behind so many classic Take That hits and a true pop institution.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Grammy-winning British singer Billy Ocean, known for "Caribbean Queen," celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Billy Ocean
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams, get into my car... and wish Billy Ocean a very happy 77th birthday!

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Inauguration
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989.

angles.name: Rock Hall of Fame history
angles.copy: Thinking back to 1989 when the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame first opened its doors to legends like Elvis, Chuck Berry, and The Beatles.

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That star Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Mark Owen
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen – still got that boyband charm!

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance on the Apple Corps rooftop in London on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Concert Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles took to the rooftop for their legendary final live performance. What a way to go out.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The legendary drummer and singer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Phil Collins
angles.copy: Another year in paradise for Phil Collins, who turns 76 today!

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies, celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Hugh Grant
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the quintessential British charmer, Hugh Grant. Still got it.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Justin Timberlake
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to Justin Timberlake – bringing sexy back for decades now.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: National treasure Sir David Jason, famous for his roles as Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday David Jason
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since the tragic plane crash that claimed the lives of Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

angles.name: Remembering music legends
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, whose lives were tragically cut short 68 years ago today on "The Day The Music Died."

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: The iconic voice behind "Never Gonna Give You Up," Rick Astley, celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rick Astley
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! We're never gonna give him up.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The legendary reggae icon Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Tribute to Bob Marley
angles.copy: Celebrating the life and music of Bob Marley on what would have been his 82nd birthday. One love, one heart.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Singer-songwriter legend Carole King, known for "Tapestry," celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Carole King
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King, a true songwriting genius.

events.title: Whitney Houston's Passing
events.blurb: Today marks 15 years since the world lost the incomparable voice of Whitney Houston.

angles.name: Remembering Whitney
angles.copy: Remembering the powerhouse voice of Whitney Houston, 15 years since her passing. Her music truly lives on.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: It's 31 years today since Take That famously announced their split, breaking millions of hearts.

angles.name: Take That history
angles.copy: Thirty-one years ago, Take That broke up, and the world wept. Thankfully, they got back together!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of UB40, Ali Campbell, celebrates his 68th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ali Campbell
angles.copy: Red, Red Wine and a happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell from UB40!

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ed Sheeran
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to Suffolk's finest, Ed Sheeran! Still making those perfect pop tunes.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: The quiet Beatle, George Harrison, would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: Tribute to George Harrison
angles.copy: Remembering George Harrison on what would have been his 84th birthday, a true musical light.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The iconic frontman of The Who, Roger Daltrey, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Roger Daltrey
angles.copy: Hope you have a smashing 83rd birthday, Roger Daltrey! Long live rock.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: British 80s pop icon Nik Kershaw, known for "Wouldn't It Be Good," celebrates his 69th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Nik Kershaw
angles.copy: Wouldn't it be good... to wish Nik Kershaw a very happy 69th birthday? We certainly think so.
